about_the_game:
Follow Ray Bibbia 10 years in the past in this adventure set in a small village where religion is considered only a fad of the past. Unveil the mystery that lurks in Castel di Vania and get ready to face ancient demons with only the help of your trusty bible and your typing skills.

Features:

  • 3 new exciting boss fights
  • A new adventure set in the past
  • 3 new twisted typing mechanics that will challenge your skills
  • New adrenaline infused soundtrack by Carbon Killer
  • A story that fits all the letters between B and Z Horror Movies
  • type new spells and dodge new bullets at the very old same time
  • Not a NFT, buy at your own risk
